<!-- ===========================================================================
  CENGAGE FORMS
  Three small scripts: CMS-driven dropdown options, the conditional field
  reveal, and automatic tracking values. Options for every other dropdown are
  typed into the <select> in the Designer.
=========================================================================== -->
<style>
  /* .form-contact_field is display:flex, and that beats the plain `hidden`
     attribute, so the attribute on its own would hide nothing. */
  .form-contact_field[hidden] { display: none !important }
  .form-contact_field-row[hidden] { display: none !important }
</style>

<script>
/* CMS-DRIVEN DROPDOWN OPTIONS
   A dropdown can take its options from a Webflow Collection List instead of
   having them typed in. Pair the two in the Designer with one attribute each:

     on the Collection List   cg-options-for  = "discipline"
     on the <select>          cg-data-element = "discipline"

   cg-options-for is the PAIRING KEY, not a styling hook: this script finds
   lists by that attribute and reads its value to locate the matching dropdown.
   Hide the list with the `hide` utility class, which also hides it on the
   Designer canvas - head CSS does not apply there.

   The list renders one element per CMS item; this reads each item's text,
   builds the <option> elements, and then removes the list, so the published
   markup is an ordinary dropdown. Editing the collection is then all it takes
   to change the field - no Designer, no deploy.

   In use: discipline, from the Disciplines collection.

   The first option is a placeholder with an empty value, so a Required select
   still refuses to submit until something is chosen. Value equals label, which
   is what the CRM expects for discipline (open text).

   Custom code does not run on the Designer canvas, so the select looks empty
   while you work. Check it on a published page. */
(function () {
  if (window.__cengageCmsOptions) return;
  window.__cengageCmsOptions = true;

  function build(list) {
    var key = list.getAttribute('cg-options-for');
    if (!key) return;

    var sel = 'select[cg-data-element="' + key + '"]';
    var form = list.closest('form');
    var select = (form && form.querySelector(sel)) || document.querySelector(sel);
    if (!select) return;                       // no dropdown with that key

    var values = [];
    list.querySelectorAll('.w-dyn-item').forEach(function (item) {
      var label = (item.textContent || '').trim();
      if (label && values.indexOf(label) === -1) values.push(label);
    });
    if (!values.length) return;                // empty collection: leave it alone

    var first = select.options[0];
    var frag = document.createDocumentFragment();

    var ph = document.createElement('option');
    ph.value = '';
    ph.textContent = (first && !first.value) ? first.text : 'Select one...';
    frag.appendChild(ph);

    values.forEach(function (v) {
      var o = document.createElement('option');
      o.value = v;
      o.textContent = v;
      frag.appendChild(o);
    });

    select.innerHTML = '';
    select.appendChild(frag);
    if (list.parentNode) list.parentNode.removeChild(list);
  }

  function init() { document.querySelectorAll('[cg-options-for]').forEach(build); }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  else init();
})();
</script>




<!-- ===========================================================================
  COUNTRY MODAL SEARCH
  Filters the country rows in the "Find Your Local Cengage Site" modal as the
  visitor types. Opening and closing the modal is a native Webflow Interaction,
  not code - this is only the filter.
=========================================================================== -->
<script>
/* The rows live in the global nav component, so they exist on every page.
   Pairing is by attribute, the same convention the forms scripts use:

     search input   cg-data-element = "country-search"
     each row       cg-data-element = "country-row"
     the modal      cg-data-element = "country-modal"

   The country names are read from the rows themselves, so the list is nowhere
   in this file - adding a country needs no code change. Matching is on the
   row's whole text, which is the flag plus the name. */
(function () {
  if (window.__cengageCountrySearch) return;
  window.__cengageCountrySearch = true;

  document.addEventListener('input', function (e) {
    var input = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('[cg-data-element="country-search"]');
    if (!input) return;

    var modal = input.closest('[cg-data-element="country-modal"]');
    if (!modal) return;

    var q = input.value.trim().toLowerCase();

    modal.querySelectorAll('[cg-data-element="country-row"]').forEach(function (row) {
      var match = row.textContent.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1;
      row.style.display = match ? '' : 'none';
    });
  });
})();
</script>
<style>
  [cg-data-element="regional-redirect-go"] {
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
</style>
<style>
  [cg-data-element="regional-redirect-modal"][hidden] {
    display: none !important;
  }
</style>
<!--
  Early header-state read, site-wide (optional). Paste at the very top of Site settings > Custom
  Code > Head code if every page should start CMP's header-state request before any script loads.
  nav-state (every page), nav-search and search-results reuse it instead of fetching their own;
  without it they still share one request between them, it just starts later.
  The /s head snippet (search-results-head.html) carries the same statement; whichever runs first
  wins and the other does nothing. Contract: scripts-src/header/shared-header-state.ts (v1).
-->
<script>
  /* One header-state read per page load, started before any script loads. nav-state, nav-search
     and search-results all reuse it (contract: scripts-src/header/shared-header-state.ts, v1);
     without it they share a single request of their own. Skipped if one was already started. */
  try {
    (function (w) {
      if (w.__cgHeaderState || typeof w.fetch !== "function") return;
      var url = "/api/cart/header-state";
      var p = w
        .fetch(url, {
          credentials: "same-origin",
          cache: "no-store",
          headers: { accept: "application/json" },
        })
        .then(function (r) {
          var res = { ok: r.ok, status: r.status, headers: r.headers, body: null };
          if (!r.ok) return res;
          return r.json().then(function (body) {
            res.body = body;
            return res;
          });
        });
      p["catch"](function () {});
      w.__cgHeaderState = { v: 1, url: url, promise: p };
    })(window);
  } catch (e) {}
</script>

<script>
/* Qualified chat, per environment. Every entry host serves the same Webflow site, so whether Qualified loads
   is decided here from the hostname, using the same host map as the helper app scripts.
   dev (int-www, staging-cms, *.webflow.io) and qa (qa-www) always load it.
   prod (www, apex, production-cms, and any host not listed) loads it only when PROD_ACTIVE is true.
   The qualified() stub is always defined, so any page code that calls qualified(...) never throws;
   when Qualified is gated off, those calls just queue and are never sent. */
(function (w, d) {
  var PROD_ACTIVE = false; /* flip to true to turn Qualified on in production */
  var TOKEN = '92tNYFgwmBS4KTkn';

  var ENVS = {
    'int-www.cengage.com': 'dev',
    'staging-cms.cengage.com': 'dev',
    'wip-cengage.webflow.io': 'dev',
    'qa-www.cengage.com': 'qa',
    'www.cengage.com': 'prod',
    'cengage.com': 'prod',
    'production-cms.cengage.com': 'prod'
  };
  var host = location.hostname;
  /* Unlisted hosts are treated as prod, so a new or unexpected host stays gated off by default. */
  var env = ENVS[host] || (/\.webflow\.io$/.test(host) ? 'dev' : 'prod');

  /* Qualified's standard queueing stub */
  w.QualifiedObject = 'qualified';
  w.qualified = w.qualified || function () { (w.qualified.q = w.qualified.q || []).push(arguments); };

  if (env === 'prod' && !PROD_ACTIVE) {
    console.info('[cg-qualified] gated off on ' + host + ' (env: prod, PROD_ACTIVE=false)');
    return;
  }

  var s = d.createElement('script');
  s.async = true;
  s.src = 'https://js.qualified.com/qualified.js?token=' + TOKEN;
  d.head.appendChild(s);
})(window, document);
</script>

/* PDP-STYLES (Global Styles): product detail page CSS the class panel cannot express.
   The PDP route (/c/<slug>/<isbn>) is rendered by the Webflow Cloud app, not by a Webflow
   page - its HTML carries no data-wf-page and its stylesheets are the app's own bundles - so
   page-level custom code never reaches it. Global Styles does, because the app ships this
   component along with the nav and the footer in its DevLink export. One consequence worth
   knowing: that export is taken at BUILD time, so an embed added here is live on
   Webflow-rendered pages as soon as the site is published, but only reaches /c/* after the
   front-end team's next DevLink export + deploy.

   ----- PRICING AND FORMATS, SINGLE PLATFORM (Figma 14028:62894 vs 13294:38277) -----
   With two platforms the cards sit side by side and each stacks vertically: name, description,
   price rows, button. That is correct and stays.
   With ONE platform the card has to run the full width of the list and split in two - the
   platform name and description on the left, the price rows and the adopt button on the right.
   Today the single card keeps its half-width column and stacks, which is the bug.

   COUNTING THE CARDS. There is no class for "only one platform", so the count has to come out
   of the structure - and the structure is not the same in the two places this CSS runs:
     Designer / Webflow pages:  .pdp-pricing_grid > .slot-contents (display:contents) > card, card, ...
     Cloud app (/c/*):          .pdp-pricing_grid > div.wf-devlink-<hash> (display:contents) > card
                                ... one wrapper per card.
   So `.pdp-pricing_card:only-child` is useless (in the app every card is the only child of its
   own wrapper) and `> :nth-child(2)` alone is useless (in the Designer the grid always has
   exactly one child, the slot). The pair of :not()s below covers both: the grid must hold a
   card, must not have a second direct child (the app's second wrapper), and must not hold two
   sibling cards (the Designer's second card). Both wrappers are display:contents, so the CARD
   is still the grid item either way - only the selector has to walk through them.
   :has() is already the idiom here - see `.nav-menu_columns:has(.nav-menu_column:only-child)`
   in nav-styles. Note :has() cannot be nested inside :has(), which is why this is two flat
   :not() tests rather than one clever one.

   Measured on staging at 1440 (one-card tab): before - grid 1296 wide, two 640 columns, card
   stuck in the left one. After - card 1296 wide, two 607 columns 32px apart, header and prices
   both starting at the top. Multi-card lists re-checked in both markups: untouched.

   Desktop only: below 992 the grid is a single column already and the stacked card is the
   design, so the whole block sits inside the 992 query. */
@media (min-width: 992px) {
  /* A list holding a single card: give it the full row instead of half of it. */
  .pdp-pricing_grid:has(.pdp-pricing_card):not(:has(> :nth-child(2))):not(:has(.pdp-pricing_card ~ .pdp-pricing_card)) {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }

  /* ...and split that card in two. */
  .pdp-pricing_grid:has(.pdp-pricing_card):not(:has(> :nth-child(2))):not(:has(.pdp-pricing_card ~ .pdp-pricing_card)) .pdp-pricing_card {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
    column-gap: 2rem;
    row-gap: 1rem;
    align-items: start;
  }

  /* Anything that is not the header flows down the right column, so this holds whether the
     card renders the options and the button as two children or wraps them in one. */
  .pdp-pricing_grid:has(.pdp-pricing_card):not(:has(> :nth-child(2))):not(:has(.pdp-pricing_card ~ .pdp-pricing_card)) .pdp-pricing_card > * {
    grid-column: 2;
  }
  .pdp-pricing_grid:has(.pdp-pricing_card):not(:has(> :nth-child(2))):not(:has(.pdp-pricing_card ~ .pdp-pricing_card)) .pdp-pricing_card > .pdp-pricing_card-header {
    grid-column: 1;
    grid-row: 1;
  }
}
/* Long SAP titles can hold one unbreakable token (`Cable/Freund/Hoisington/...`) - browsers do not
   break after a solidus, so the h1 runs under the purchase card and the left grid track takes its
   minimum from that word, pushing the aside off-screen. Both rules are needed: either one alone
   leaves half the bug. `anywhere`, not `break-word` - only `anywhere` counts towards min-content.
   Inert on normal titles; breaks mid-name, so the real fix is `/<wbr>` app-side. */
.pdp_layout > * { min-width: 0; }
.pdp_layout * { overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

class="nav_custom-code w-embed w-script"><script>
/* ==================================================================================================
   NAV GLOBAL - custom code.  One embed (`nav_custom-code`, last child of the nav root), four scripts.

   SCRIPT ONLY.  Everything this nav needs in CSS beyond the class panel - motion, w--open / w--current
   descendants, parent-hover, reduced motion, the mobile drill-down panels - lives in Global Styles
   (`nav-styles`, `nav-motion-styles`, `nav-signin-mobile`).  Every state set here is a NATIVE combo
   class on the element it changes, per rules/cengage-nav-states-2026-09-30.md; nothing here reads an
   ancestor's state class.

   WHAT IS IN THE FOUR SCRIPTS
     1/4  BAR             active section, search, Tablet accordion, sub bar, desktop pill, scroll, ARIA.
     2/4  DRILL-DOWN      the <=991px slide-in panels, the Sign In markets and the country modal.
     3/4  COUNTRY GUARDS  stop clicks inside the country card from closing the Webflow dropdown.
     4/4  FADED MENU A11Y take the faded desktop menu out of the a11y tree and the tab order.

   WHY FOUR SCRIPTS AND NOT ONE
   A syntax error kills its own <script> tag and nothing else, and this component is on every page of
   the site, so the blast radius is kept small on purpose.  Their ORDER does not matter: 2/4 and 3/4
   bind on window in the capture phase and 1/4 binds on document, and capture always travels
   window -> document whatever order the listeners were added in (see the note on 2/4).

   WHEN THEY RUN
   1/4 sections 1-4 and 6 wait for DOMContentLoaded, so element order in the markup is irrelevant;
   1/4 section 5 (scroll) and all of 2/4, 3/4 and 4/4 bind at parse time, which is why the nav already
   has its correct top state on the first paint.
   ==================================================================================================

   ===== 1/4  BAR =====
   1. Active section: .is-active on the matching .nav_menu-toggle / .nav-sub_toggle.
   2. Search: open / close / typing / recent searches (localStorage) / Search results page (main[data-nav-search="open"]
      loads open, query echoed from ?query= or ?q=). Fires cg:search-open / cg:search-close on .nav_component.
      Opening never shifts the bar: on desktop only the absolutely positioned field row changes width.
   3. Tablet (<=991px): tap accordion inside the native hamburger Dropdown; the sub bar moves under Higher Education.
      Mini cart close X (every width).
   4. Desktop: the shared .nav_menu-pill follows the hovered / open mega menu toggle.
   5. Scroll: hides on scroll down, returns on scroll up; no bottom line at the top of the page.
   6. Disclosure ARIA: nav dropdown toggles drop the aria-haspopup="menu" Webflow stamps on them (WFCMS-1002). */
(function(){
  function boot(){
    var nav=document.querySelector('.nav_component'); if(!nav) return;
    var mq=window.matchMedia('(max-width: 991px)');
    var still=window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
    function q(s){return nav.querySelector(s);}
    function cls(el,c,on){if(el) el.classList.toggle(c,on);}

    /* ---- 1. active section ---- */
    var norm=function(h){h=(h||'').split('?')[0].split('#')[0].replace(/\/+$/,'');return h||'/';};
    var path=norm(location.pathname);
    var subLink=q('.nav-sub_logo-link'); var section=subLink?norm(subLink.getAttribute('href')):null;
    nav.querySelectorAll('.nav_menu-toggle, .nav-sub_toggle').forEach(function(t){
      var list=t.nextElementSibling; var a=list?list.querySelector('.mega-menu_title-col a[href], .mega-menu_head a[href]'):null; if(!a) return;
      var href=norm(a.getAttribute('href')); if(href==='#') return;
      if(href===path||(t.classList.contains('nav_menu-toggle')&&section&&href===section)) t.classList.add('is-active');
    });

    /* ---- dropdown helpers (Tablet accordion). The hamburger itself belongs to Webflow. ---- */
    var hamburger=q('.nav_mobile-toggle'), mobileList=q('.nav_mobile-list'), menu=q('.nav_menu');
    function listOf(t){var p=t.parentElement;return p?p.querySelector(':scope > .w-dropdown-list'):null;}
    function setDrop(t,on){t.classList.toggle('w--open',on);var l=listOf(t);if(l)l.classList.toggle('w--open',on);t.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(on));}
    function closeDrops(except,root){(root||nav).querySelectorAll('.w-dropdown-toggle.w--open').forEach(function(t){if(t!==except&&t!==hamburger)setDrop(t,false);});}
    function menuOpen(){return !!(mobileList&&mobileList.classList.contains('w--open'));}

    /* ---- 6. disclosure ARIA (WFCMS-1002): Webflow's Dropdown stamps aria-haspopup="menu" on every toggle at init,
       which makes screen readers promise arrow-key menu navigation the panels do not have. The nav dropdowns are
       disclosures: the toggle keeps aria-expanded + aria-controls (Webflow maintains them) and Tab walks the panel.
       The observer catches Webflow's init whether it runs before or after this script. ---- */
    nav.querySelectorAll('.w-dropdown-toggle').forEach(function(t){
      var strip=function(){if(t.hasAttribute('aria-haspopup'))t.removeAttribute('aria-haspopup');};
      strip();
      if(window.MutationObserver) new MutationObserver(strip).observe(t,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['aria-haspopup']});
    });

    /* ---- 2. search ---- */
    var wrap=q('.nav_search'), form=q('.nav_search-form'), input=q('.nav_search-input');
    var searchOpen=function(){return false;}, fadeMenu=function(){}, reapplySearch=function(){};
    if(wrap&&form&&input){
      var bar=q('.nav_bar'), actions=q('.nav_actions'), row=q('.nav_search-form-wrapper'), scrim=q('.nav_scrim');
      var clear=wrap.querySelector('.nav_search-clear'), close=wrap.querySelector('.nav_search-close'), results=wrap.querySelector('.nav_search-results');
      var glyph=q('.nav_utility-search-icon'), glyphClose=q('.nav_utility-search-icon-close');
      var toggles=[q('.nav_utility-search')].filter(Boolean); /* the mobile magnifier; desktop opens on focus */
      var recentSection=results?results.querySelector('[data-search="recent"]'):null;
      var suggestions=results?results.querySelector('[data-search="suggestions"]'):null;
      var products=results?results.querySelector('[data-search="products"]'):null;
      var recentList=recentSection?recentSection.querySelector('[data-search="recent-list"]'):null;
      var rowTpl=recentList&&recentList.firstElementChild?recentList.firstElementChild.cloneNode(true):null;
      var KEY='cengage-recent-searches';
      var persist=!!document.querySelector('[data-nav-search="open"]');
      function recent(){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY)||'[]')}catch(e){return []}}
      function save(list){try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(list.slice(0,5)))}catch(e){}}
      function isOpen(){return wrap.classList.contains('is-open');}
      searchOpen=isOpen;
      function typing(){return input.value.trim().length>0;}
      function renderRecent(){
        if(!recentList||!rowTpl) return;
        recentList.innerHTML='';
        recent().forEach(function(v){var r=rowTpl.cloneNode(true);r.classList.remove('hide');r.setAttribute('href','/s/?query='+encodeURIComponent(v));var t=r.querySelector('[data-search="row-text"]');if(t)t.textContent=v;recentList.appendChild(r);});
      }
      /* Which blocks of the dropdown are visible: recent searches BEFORE typing, suggestions + products while typing. */
      function sync(){
        var open=isOpen(), t=typing(), has=recent().length>0;
        cls(clear,'hide',!(open&&t));
        cls(recentSection,'hide',t||!has);
        cls(suggestions,'hide',!t);
        cls(products,'hide',!t);
        cls(results,'hide',!(open&&(t||has)&&(!persist||wrap.contains(document.activeElement))));
      }
      /* Desktop grow without layout shift: while open the field row is absolutely positioned (native combo) and only
         ITS inline width animates, from the closed field to the menu's left edge. .nav_search keeps its closed width
         through an inline min-width, so no sibling in the bar moves or reflows. */
      var closeTimer=null, closedW=0;
      /* Left edge = the menu's slot (.nav_mobile stays in place on desktop even when the menu itself is hidden). */
      var slot=q('.nav_mobile')||menu;
      function growTarget(){var s=wrap.getBoundingClientRect(),m=slot?slot.getBoundingClientRect():null;return Math.max(closedW,Math.round(s.right-(m?m.left:s.left)));}
      function growOpen(){
        clearTimeout(closeTimer);
        if(!row) return;
        if(!row.classList.contains('is-open')){
          closedW=Math.round(row.getBoundingClientRect().width);
          wrap.style.minWidth=Math.round(wrap.getBoundingClientRect().width)+'px';
          row.style.width=closedW+'px';
          if(still.matches) row.style.transition='none';
          cls(row,'is-open',true); cls(form,'is-open',true);
          void row.offsetWidth; /* commit the start width so the transition runs */
        }
        var w=growTarget()+'px'; row.style.width=w;
        if(results){results.style.left='auto';results.style.right='0';results.style.width=w;}
      }
      function clearGrow(){
        clearTimeout(closeTimer);
        cls(row,'is-open',false); cls(form,'is-open',false);
        if(row) row.style.width=''; wrap.style.minWidth='';
        if(results){results.style.left='';results.style.right='';results.style.width='';}
      }
      function growClose(){
        clearTimeout(closeTimer);
        if(!row||!row.classList.contains('is-open')||still.matches||persist){clearGrow();return;}
        row.style.width=closedW+'px';
        closeTimer=setTimeout(clearGrow,440); /* matches the 420ms native width transition */
      }
      /* Tablet: the row under the bar moves with scroll and wrapping - pin the scrim and the results to its real bottom. */
      function pin(){
        var b=(isOpen()&&mq.matches&&row)?Math.round(row.getBoundingClientRect().bottom)+'px':'';
        if(scrim) scrim.style.top=b;
        if(results){results.style.top=b;results.style.maxHeight=b?'calc(100vh - '+b+')':'';}
        if(isOpen()&&!mq.matches&&row&&row.classList.contains('is-open')) growOpen(); /* desktop resize: re-measure */
      }
      /* Desktop: the links fade out under the growing field (motion in nav-styles), or simply hide without motion. */
      fadeMenu=function(){var desk=isOpen()&&!mq.matches;cls(menu,'is-faded',desk&&!still.matches);cls(menu,'hide',desk&&still.matches);};
      function setOpen(on){
        cls(bar,'is-open',on); cls(actions,'is-open',on); cls(wrap,'is-open',on);
        if(!mq.matches){ if(on) growOpen(); else growClose(); }
        else { clearGrow(); cls(row,'is-open',on); cls(form,'is-open',on); }
        cls(close,'hide',!on);
        /* The scrim dims the page behind the Tablet search. On the search results page the field
           loads open on purpose - it shows the current query - but the scrim has no business
           being there: it covered the results with a 55% navy sheet that ate every tap on the
           filters, the sort and the product cards until the X was pressed (WFCMS search-overlay
           ticket, 2026-10-19). Open stays open; only the dimming is skipped. */
        cls(scrim,'hide',!on||persist);
        /* The bar keeps its magnifier while the search is open. It used to swap to an X, which put
           two of them on screen at Tablet - one in the bar and the field's own - and read as a
           duplicate (client call 2026-10-16). The button still shuts the search when tapped, so
           nothing is lost; .nav_utility-search-icon-close stays hidden and is now unused markup. */
        cls(glyph,'hide',false); cls(glyphClose,'hide',true);
        fadeMenu();
        toggles.forEach(function(t){t.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(on));});
        sync(); requestAnimationFrame(pin);
      }
      function open(){if(isOpen())return;renderRecent();setOpen(true);nav.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('cg:search-open',{bubbles:true}));}
      function shut(){if(!isOpen())return;setOpen(false);nav.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('cg:search-close',{bubbles:true}));}
      function inToggle(el){return toggles.some(function(t){return t.contains(el);});}
      /* Crossing the Tablet breakpoint while open: rebuild the open state in the other layout. */
      reapplySearch=function(){if(!isOpen())return;setOpen(false);clearGrow();setOpen(true);};
      input.addEventListener('focus',open);
      input.addEventListener('input',sync);
      toggles.forEach(function(t){
        t.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
        t.addEventListener('click',function(e){e.preventDefault();if(isOpen()){shut();input.blur();}else{open();input.focus();}});
      });
      if(close) close.addEventListener('click',function(){input.value='';shut();input.blur();});
      if(clear) clear.addEventListener('click',function(){input.value='';sync();input.focus();});
      var ch=results?results.querySelector('[data-search="clear-history"]'):null;
      if(ch) ch.addEventListener('click',function(){save([]);renderRecent();sync();input.focus();});
      form.addEventListener('submit',function(){var v=input.value.trim();if(!v)return;var l=recent().filter(function(x){return x.toLowerCase()!==v.toLowerCase();});l.unshift(v);save(l);});
      document.addEventListener('pointerdown',function(e){if(!persist&&isOpen()&&!wrap.contains(e.target)&&!inToggle(e.target))shut();});
      document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Escape'&&isOpen()){shut();input.blur();}});
      window.addEventListener('scroll',function(){if(isOpen())pin();},{passive:true});
      window.addEventListener('resize',pin);
      /* The actions change width after load without a window resize - the signed-in label and the mini-cart arrive
         from the account scripts (WFCMS-1241). .nav_actions itself is flex-grown and keeps its size, so watch the
         items beside the field: when they widen, the field (locked by min-width) is pushed left and its measured
         inline width would run over the logo - re-measure then. */
      if(window.ResizeObserver&&actions){
        var actionsRO=new ResizeObserver(function(){if(isOpen())pin();});
        [].forEach.call(actions.children,function(c){if(c!==wrap)actionsRO.observe(c);});
      }
      renderRecent(); sync();
      if(persist){
        /* Search results page: no entrance motion, the dropdown only while the field has focus. */
        [actions,wrap,row,form].concat([].slice.call(nav.querySelectorAll('.nav_menu-item'))).forEach(function(el){if(el)el.style.transition='none';});
        if(close) close.style.animation='none'; if(clear) clear.style.animation='none';
        wrap.addEventListener('focusin',sync); wrap.addEventListener('focusout',function(){setTimeout(sync,0);});
        var sp=new URLSearchParams(location.search); var v=sp.get('query')||sp.get('q')||'';
        if(v&&!input.value) input.value=v;
        open();
      }
    }

    /* ---- 3. Tablet accordion inside the native hamburger menu ----
       Below 992px the drill-down (2/4) claims .nav_menu-toggle, .nav_menu-signin-toggle and
       .nav-sub_toggle on WINDOW capture and stops them before they ever reach this document-level
       handler, so what it actually serves today is the toggles the drill-down does not take: the
       info (?) menu and the mini-cart. It is left general on purpose - it is also the fallback if
       2/4 bails out of boot(), which it does when the panel head markup is missing. ---- */
    if(mobileList&&window.MutationObserver){
      /* Webflow closed the menu (outside tap, Escape): reset the accordion so it never reopens with a panel expanded. */
      new MutationObserver(function(){if(!menuOpen())closeDrops(null,mobileList);}).observe(mobileList,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class']});
    }
    var INNER='.nav_menu-toggle, .nav_menu-signin-toggle, .nav_info-toggle, .nav-cart_toggle, .nav-sub_toggle';
    document.addEventListener('click',function(e){
      if(!mq.matches) return;
      var t=e.target.closest(INNER);
      /* Only real Webflow dropdown toggles open the accordion. Plain link items (K-12, Career and Workforce) reuse
         .nav_menu-toggle for their look and must navigate normally. */
      if(!t||!nav.contains(t)||!t.classList.contains('w-dropdown-toggle')) return;
      /* Capture phase: Webflow's hover-open would otherwise reopen what the tap closes. One panel at a time. */
      e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation();
      var on=!t.classList.contains('w--open');
      closeDrops(t); setDrop(t,on);
    },true);
    /* Tapping the page behind the bar closes the cart. */
    document.addEventListener('click',function(e){
      if(!mq.matches) return;
      var cart=q('.nav-cart');
      if(cart&&!cart.contains(e.target)){var ct=cart.querySelector('.nav-cart_toggle');if(ct&&ct.classList.contains('w--open'))setDrop(ct,false);}
    });
    /* Mini cart close X (Figma Mini Cart 15967:39050 / 39961 / 40913): shuts the cart dropdown and hands focus back
       to the toggle. Tablet uses the accordion helper above; desktop asks Webflow's own dropdown to close, so its
       internal open state stays in sync (a plain class removal would let the next hover think it is still open). */
    var cartClose=q('[cg-data-element="nav-cart-close"]');
    if(cartClose) cartClose.addEventListener('click',function(e){
      e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
      var cart=q('.nav-cart'), ct=cart?cart.querySelector('.nav-cart_toggle'):null;
      if(!cart||!ct) return;
      if(mq.matches||!window.jQuery) setDrop(ct,false);
      else window.jQuery(cart).triggerHandler('w-close.w-dropdown');
      if(ct.classList.contains('w--open')) setDrop(ct,false); /* fallback if Webflow did not close it */
      ct.focus();
    });

    /* ---- 3b. sub bar -> Tablet menu (Figma 14260:118111) ---- */
    var sub=q('.nav-sub_component');
    var home=sub?sub.parentElement:null, nextAtHome=sub?sub.nextElementSibling:null;
    function anchor(){
      var t=[].slice.call(menu.querySelectorAll('.nav_menu-toggle')).filter(function(x){return /higher\s*education/i.test(x.textContent);})[0];
      return t?t.closest('.nav_menu-item'):null;
    }
    function placeSub(){
      if(!sub||!menu) return;
      if(mq.matches){
        if(sub.parentElement!==menu){var a=anchor();if(a)a.insertAdjacentElement('afterend',sub);else menu.appendChild(sub);}
        sub.classList.add('is-in-menu');
      }else{
        if(sub.parentElement!==home){if(nextAtHome&&nextAtHome.parentElement===home)home.insertBefore(sub,nextAtHome);else home.appendChild(sub);}
        sub.classList.remove('is-in-menu');
      }
      closeDrops(null,sub); /* never start with a panel left open by a desktop hover */
    }
    placeSub();

    /* ---- 4. desktop pill ---- */
    var pill=menu?menu.querySelector('.nav_menu-pill'):null;
    var tops=menu?[].slice.call(menu.querySelectorAll('.nav_menu-item > .nav_menu-toggle')):[];
    var motion=window.matchMedia('(min-width: 992px) and (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)');
    var hoverT=null;
    tops.forEach(function(t){var l=t.querySelector('.nav_menu-label');if(l&&!l.getAttribute('data-t'))l.setAttribute('data-t',l.textContent.trim());});
    function openTop(){for(var i=0;i<tops.length;i++){if(tops[i].classList.contains('w--open'))return tops[i];}return null;}
    function placePill(){
      if(!pill) return;
      var o=openTop(), t=o||hoverT;
      if(!t||!motion.matches||searchOpen()){pill.classList.remove('is-on','is-open');return;}
      var wasOff=!pill.classList.contains('is-on');
      if(wasOff) pill.style.transition='none'; /* first appearance: no glide from x=0 */
      pill.style.left=t.offsetLeft+'px'; pill.style.width=t.offsetWidth+'px';
      if(wasOff){void pill.offsetWidth;pill.style.transition='';}
      pill.classList.add('is-on'); pill.classList.toggle('is-open',!!o);
    }
    tops.forEach(function(t){
      t.addEventListener('pointerenter',function(){hoverT=t;placePill();});
      t.addEventListener('pointerleave',function(){if(hoverT===t)hoverT=null;placePill();});
    });
    if(window.MutationObserver&&pill){
      var mo=new MutationObserver(placePill);
      tops.forEach(function(t){mo.observe(t,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class']});});
      if(wrap) mo.observe(wrap,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class']});
    }
    window.addEventListener('resize',placePill);

    /* Crossing the Tablet breakpoint: close a Webflow-open hamburger, reset the accordion, move the sub bar, re-pin. */
    var onChange=function(){
      if(!mq.matches&&menuOpen()&&hamburger) hamburger.click();
      if(!mq.matches) closeDrops(null);
      placeSub(); placePill(); reapplySearch(); fadeMenu();
    };
    if(mq.addEventListener) mq.addEventListener('change',onChange); else if(mq.addListener) mq.addListener(onChange);
  }
  /* ---- 5. scroll: the nav hides while the page scrolls down and comes back on scroll up (.nav_component.is-hidden).
     At the very top the nav has no bottom line (.is-top on the lowest bar: the sub bar on desktop, otherwise .nav_bar).
     Runs right away (the script sits inside the nav), so the top state is set before the first paint. ---- */
  (function(){
    var nav=(document.currentScript&&document.currentScript.closest('.nav_component'))||document.querySelector('.nav_component'); if(!nav) return;
    var still=window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
    var last=Math.max(0,window.scrollY), ticking=false;
    function busy(){return !!nav.querySelector('.w--open, .nav_search.is-open');}
    function update(){
      ticking=false;
      var bar=nav.querySelector('.nav_bar'), sub=nav.querySelector('.nav-sub_component');
      var y=Math.max(0,window.scrollY), top=y<=0, d=y-last;
      var lowest=(sub&&!sub.classList.contains('is-in-menu'))?sub:bar;
      if(bar) bar.classList.toggle('is-top',top&&lowest===bar);
      if(sub) sub.classList.toggle('is-top',top&&lowest===sub);
      if(top||busy()||d<-4) nav.classList.remove('is-hidden');
      else if(d>4&&y>nav.offsetHeight) nav.classList.add('is-hidden');
      if(top||Math.abs(d)>4) last=y;
    }
    function onScroll(){if(!ticking){ticking=true;requestAnimationFrame(update);}}
    nav.style.transition=still.matches?'none':'';
    window.addEventListener('scroll',onScroll,{passive:true});
    window.addEventListener('resize',onScroll);
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',onScroll);
    nav.addEventListener('focusin',function(){nav.classList.remove('is-hidden');});
    update();
  })();

  if(document.readyState==='loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',boot); else boot();
})();
</script>

<script>
/* ===== 2/4  MOBILE DRILL-DOWN =====
   The <=991px menu is not an accordion but a stack of panels that slide in over one another, each
   one carrying the single shared header (.nav_panel-head: back arrow + title). The panels' own CSS
   lives in Global Styles, not here.

   WHY THE LISTENERS ARE ON WINDOW, IN CAPTURE
   1/4 binds its Tablet accordion on DOCUMENT in capture and calls stopImmediatePropagation(). Capture
   travels window -> document, so a window listener runs FIRST no matter which script registered
   first - that is what lets this module take over the toggles below 992px while 1/4 keeps the ones it
   is not given. Moving these listeners to document, or dropping the `true`, silently hands the menu
   back to the accordion.

   Panels are MOVED in the DOM, not duplicated: homes/remember()/restore() put every borrowed element
   back exactly where it came from, so nothing leaks when the breakpoint changes. Two things follow
   from moving rather than copying, and both have bitten: whatever is pushed must be something whose
   absence costs the panel underneath no height (see openMarket), and the single shared header has to
   leave a stand-in behind (see push). */
(function(){
  var SLIDE=320;
  function boot(){
    var nav=document.querySelector('.nav_component'); if(!nav) return;
    var list=nav.querySelector('.nav_mobile-list');
    var menu=nav.querySelector('.nav_menu');
    var head=nav.querySelector('.nav_panel-head');
    var back=nav.querySelector('.nav_panel-back');
    var title=nav.querySelector('.nav_panel-title');
    if(!list||!menu||!head||!back||!title) return;
    var bar=nav.querySelector('.nav_bar');
    var footer=nav.querySelector('.nav_menu-footer');
    var sub=nav.querySelector('.nav-sub_component');   /* present only when Show Sub Bar is on */
    var modal=nav.querySelector('.nav-country_modal');
    var mq=window.matchMedia('(max-width: 991px)');
    var still=window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');

    var homes=new WeakMap();
    function remember(el){ if(el&&!homes.has(el)) homes.set(el,{p:el.parentElement,n:el.nextElementSibling}); }
    function restore(el){ var h=el&&homes.get(el); if(!h||!h.p) return;
      if(h.n&&h.n.parentElement===h.p) h.p.insertBefore(el,h.n); else h.p.appendChild(el); }

    var stack=[], busy=false;
    function pushed(el){ return stack.some(function(s){return s.el===el;}); }
    function label(el){
      var l=el.querySelector('.nav_menu-label, .nav-sub_label, .nav_menu-signin-label');
      return (l?l.textContent:el.textContent).replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();
    }
    /* Where the overlay starts: the real bottom edge of the bar. */
    function measure(){
      var b=bar?Math.round(bar.getBoundingClientRect().bottom):64;
      list.style.setProperty('--nav-panel-top', b+'px');
    }

    function render(){
      var top=stack[stack.length-1]||null;
      menu.classList.toggle('is-under', stack.length>0);
      head.classList.toggle('hide', stack.length===0);
      head.classList.toggle('is-navy', !!(top&&top.navy));
      title.textContent = top?top.title:'';
    }

    /* The Sign In panel lists the three markets as drill-down rows (Figma 15228:36575), and the
       rows are the <h4> group headings that were already in the markup - nothing is duplicated.
       Headings are not links, so they only become operable here, on mobile. */
    function markHeadings(on){
      [].slice.call(nav.querySelectorAll('.nav_menu-signin-list .nav-menu_heading')).forEach(function(h){
        if(on){ h.setAttribute('role','button'); h.setAttribute('tabindex','0'); }
        else { h.removeAttribute('role'); h.removeAttribute('tabindex'); }
      });
    }
    /* Push the LINK LIST, not the whole column. The row the visitor tapped is the heading, and the
       heading has to stay where it is: .nav-menu_columns is a flex column, so lifting the whole
       column out leaves a hole, the rows below slide up for the length of the animation and drop
       back when the panel settles - a visible jump on the way back. The list is display:none in
       the Sign In panel, so taking it away costs no height and nothing underneath moves. */
    function listOfMarket(h){
      var grp=h&&(h.closest('.nav-menu_group')||h.parentElement);
      return grp&&grp.querySelector('.nav-menu_list');
    }
    function openMarket(h){
      var lst=listOfMarket(h);
      if(lst) push(lst, label(h), {navy:true});
    }
    /* SIGN IN HAS TWO SHAPES. A page carrying a sub bar is a Higher Education page, so Sign In has
       only one market to offer and goes straight to its links under the title Sign In (Figma
       14612:40989) - one tap, as it was before the market level existed. Everywhere else it lists
       K-12 / Higher Education / Career & Workforce first (15228:36575). The sub bar is the same
       test the old setCols() used. */
    function hedList(){
      return listOfMarket([].slice.call(nav.querySelectorAll('.nav_menu-signin-list .nav-menu_heading'))
        .filter(function(x){ return /higher\s*education/i.test(x.textContent); })[0]);
    }
    /* SIGNED IN, the list holds the Account menu instead (the auth script removes its `hide`): push the whole
       list, skip the Higher Education shortcut, and title the panel with the toggle's own label ("Account"). */
    function openSignIn(){
      var acct=nav.querySelector('.nav_menu-signin-list .nav_account-menu:not(.hide)');
      var lbl=nav.querySelector('.nav_menu-signin-label');
      push((!acct&&sub&&hedList())||nav.querySelector('.nav_menu-signin-list'),
        (acct&&lbl&&lbl.textContent.trim())||'Sign In', {navy:true});
    }

    function push(el,t,opt){
      if(!el||!mq.matches||busy||pushed(el)) return;
      opt=opt||{};
      measure(); remember(el);
      if(footer&&footer.parentElement===list) list.insertBefore(el,footer); else list.appendChild(el);
      el.classList.add('is-panel'); el.classList.remove('is-parked','is-under');
      /* There is ONE shared header, so the panel it is taken from loses its height and every row
         in it slides up for the length of the animation, then drops back when the header returns -
         the jump you see going in and coming back. Leave a throwaway copy in its place. pop()
         sweeps it and puts the real header back in the same task, with no layout read between the
         two, so the swap is never painted. At root level the header is hidden and takes no height,
         so nothing is left behind there. */
      var from=head.parentElement;
      if(from&&from!==list&&!head.classList.contains('hide')){
        var stay=head.cloneNode(true);
        stay.classList.add('is-ghost');
        stay.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
        from.insertBefore(stay, head);
      }
      el.insertBefore(head, el.firstChild);  /* the header slides with its panel */
      stack.push({el:el,title:t,navy:!!opt.navy});
      render(); el.scrollTop=0;
      if(still.matches){ el.classList.add('is-in'); }
      else { busy=true; requestAnimationFrame(function(){ el.classList.add('is-in'); setTimeout(function(){busy=false;},SLIDE); }); }
    }

    function settle(s){
      var el=s.el;
      el.classList.remove('is-panel','is-in','is-under');
      if(el===sub) el.classList.add('is-parked');
      var top=stack[stack.length-1];
      if(top&&top.el) top.el.insertBefore(head, top.el.firstChild);
      else list.insertBefore(head, list.firstChild);
      restore(el);
      render();
    }

    /* There is only ONE header element, so going back has to decide who owns it during the slide.
       Handing it over in settle(), when the animation ends, left the panel underneath bare for the
       whole 320ms and then popped its title in at the last frame. So the handover happens up front
       instead, and the outgoing panel keeps a throwaway copy on its way out. */
    function sweep(){
      [].slice.call(nav.querySelectorAll('.nav_panel-head.is-ghost')).forEach(function(g){
        if(g.parentElement) g.parentElement.removeChild(g);
      });
    }
    function pop(){
      if(busy) return;
      sweep();
      var s=stack.pop(); if(!s) return;
      var below=stack[stack.length-1];
      if(below&&below.el) below.el.classList.remove('is-under'); else menu.classList.remove('is-under');
      if(still.matches){ settle(s); return; }
      busy=true;
      var ghost=null;
      if(head.parentElement===s.el){
        ghost=head.cloneNode(true);
        ghost.classList.add('is-ghost');
        ghost.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
        s.el.insertBefore(ghost, head);
      }
      var target=(below&&below.el)||list;
      target.insertBefore(head, target.firstChild);
      render();
      s.el.classList.remove('is-in');
      setTimeout(function(){
        if(ghost&&ghost.parentElement) ghost.parentElement.removeChild(ghost);
        settle(s); busy=false;
      }, SLIDE);
    }
    /* Instant teardown - used when the menu closes or the breakpoint changes. */
    function reset(){ busy=false; sweep(); while(stack.length){ settle(stack.pop()); } }

    function openModal(){ if(modal){ modal.classList.add('is-open'); document.body.style.overflow='hidden'; } }
    function closeModal(){ if(modal){ modal.classList.remove('is-open'); document.body.style.overflow=''; } }

    function apply(){
      markHeadings(mq.matches);
      if(mq.matches){
        measure();
        if(footer){ remember(footer); if(footer.parentElement!==list) list.appendChild(footer); }
        if(sub&&!pushed(sub)) sub.classList.add('is-parked');
      }else{
        reset(); closeModal();
        if(sub) sub.classList.remove('is-parked');
        if(footer) restore(footer);
        menu.classList.remove('is-under');
        head.classList.add('hide'); head.classList.remove('is-navy');
        list.style.removeProperty('--nav-panel-top');
      }
      render();
    }

    window.addEventListener('click',function(e){
      if(!mq.matches) return;
      var t=e.target; if(!t||!t.closest) return;

      if(modal&&modal.classList.contains('is-open')){
        if(t.closest('[cg-data-element="country-modal-close"]')||t.closest('[cg-data-element="country-modal-backdrop"]')){
          e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation(); closeModal();
        }
        return;
      }
      if(t.closest('.nav_panel-back')){ e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation(); pop(); return; }
      if(!nav.contains(t)) return;

      if(t.closest('[cg-data-element="nav-country-link"]')){ e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation(); openModal(); return; }
      if(t.closest('.nav_menu-support')){ e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation(); push(nav.querySelector('.nav_info-list'),'Support',{}); return; }
      if(t.closest('.nav_menu-signin-toggle')){ e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation(); openSignIn(); return; }

      /* K-12 / Higher Education / Career & Workforce inside the Sign In panel (Figma 15228:36955,
         37072, 37147): each market's link list slides in as its own panel. */
      var mkt=t.closest('.nav_menu-signin-list .nav-menu_heading');
      if(mkt){ e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation(); openMarket(mkt); return; }

      var st=t.closest('.nav-sub_toggle');
      if(st){ e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation();
        push(st.parentElement.querySelector(':scope > .nav-sub_mega-list'), label(st), {}); return; }

      var mt=t.closest('.nav_menu-toggle');
      /* Plain link rows (K-12, Career & Workforce) reuse .nav_menu-toggle for their look - they navigate. */
      if(mt&&mt.classList.contains('w-dropdown-toggle')){
        e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation();
        push(sub?sub:mt.parentElement.querySelector(':scope > .nav_mega-list'), label(mt), {});
      }
    },true);

    document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
      if(!mq.matches) return;
      if(e.key==='Escape'){
        if(modal&&modal.classList.contains('is-open')){ closeModal(); return; }
        if(stack.length) pop();
        return;
      }
      /* The market rows are headings, so the browser gives them no keyboard behaviour of its own. */
      if(e.key!=='Enter'&&e.key!==' '&&e.key!=='Spacebar') return;
      var h=e.target&&e.target.closest&&e.target.closest('.nav_menu-signin-list .nav-menu_heading');
      if(!h) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      openMarket(h);
    });

    if(window.MutationObserver){
      new MutationObserver(function(){
        if(!list.classList.contains('w--open')){ reset(); closeModal(); }
        else measure();
      }).observe(list,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class']});
    }

    window.addEventListener('resize',function(){ if(mq.matches) measure(); });
    window.addEventListener('scroll',function(){ if(mq.matches&&stack.length) measure(); },{passive:true});
    if(mq.addEventListener) mq.addEventListener('change',apply); else if(mq.addListener) mq.addListener(apply);
    apply();
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',boot); else boot();
})();
</script>

<script>
/* ===== 3/4  COUNTRY MODAL GUARDS =====
   The country modal is a sibling of the mobile menu, not a child of it, so to Webflow's dropdown
   every click inside the card is an OUTSIDE click: putting the cursor in the modal's search field
   closed the whole nav. These guards sit on window in capture, run after the drill-down router in
   2/4 (same phase, registered later), and stop the event before it reaches the document handlers
   that do the closing.

   stopPropagation(), not stopImmediatePropagation(): other window-capture listeners on the same
   event still run, only the document-level ones below are cut off.

   PASS is the allow-list - the country rows and the close button must keep reaching their own
   handlers, so they are let through untouched. Add anything interactive that is added to the card
   to PASS, or it will look dead. */
(function () {
  var CARD = '.nav-country_card';
  var PASS = '.nav-country_row, .nav-country_close, [cg-data-element="country-modal-close"]';

  function inside(node, sel) { return node && node.closest && node.closest(sel); }

  function guardPointer(e) {
    if (!inside(e.target, CARD)) return;
    if (inside(e.target, PASS)) return;
    e.stopPropagation();
  }

  function guardFocus(e) {
    if (inside(e.target, '.nav-country_modal') || inside(e.relatedTarget, '.nav-country_modal')) {
      e.stopPropagation();
    }
  }

  ['pointerdown', 'mousedown', 'mouseup', 'click', 'touchstart'].forEach(function (type) {
    window.addEventListener(type, guardPointer, true);
  });
  ['focusin', 'focusout'].forEach(function (type) {
    window.addEventListener(type, guardFocus, true);
  });
})();
</script>

<script>
/* ===== 4/4  FADED MENU MUST LEAVE THE ACCESSIBILITY TREE (WFCMS-809, observation 2) =====
   While the desktop search is open, fadeMenu() in 1/4 does:

     fadeMenu = function(){ var desk = isOpen() && !mq.matches;
       cls(menu, 'is-faded', desk && !still.matches);   // animated: opacity 0 only

<style>

<script>
/* CMS-DRIVEN DROPDOWN OPTIONS
   A dropdown can take its options from a Webflow Collection List instead of
   having them typed in. Pair the two in the Designer with one attribute each:

     on the Collection List   cg-options-for  = "discipline"
     on the <select>          cg-data-element = "discipline"

   cg-options-for is the PAIRING KEY, not a styling hook: this script finds
   lists by that attribute and reads its value to locate the matching dropdown.
   Hide the list with the `hide` utility class, which also hides it on the
   Designer canvas - head CSS does not apply there.

   The list renders one element per CMS item; this reads each item's text,
   builds the <option> elements, and then removes the list, so the published
   markup is an ordinary dropdown. Editing the collection is then all it takes
   to change the field - no Designer, no deploy.

   In use: discipline, from the Disciplines collection.

   The first option is a placeholder with an empty value, so a Required select
   still refuses to submit until something is chosen. Value equals label, which
   is what the CRM expects for discipline (open text).

   Custom code does not run on the Designer canvas, so the select looks empty
   while you work. Check it on a published page. */
(function () {
  if (window.__cengageCmsOptions) return;
  window.__cengageCmsOptions = true;

  function build(list) {
    var key = list.getAttribute('cg-options-for');
    if (!key) return;

    var sel = 'select[cg-data-element="' + key + '"]';
    var form = list.closest('form');
    var select = (form && form.querySelector(sel)) || document.querySelector(sel);
    if (!select) return;                       // no dropdown with that key

    var values = [];
    list.querySelectorAll('.w-dyn-item').forEach(function (item) {
      var label = (item.textContent || '').trim();
      if (label && values.indexOf(label) === -1) values.push(label);
    });
    if (!values.length) return;                // empty collection: leave it alone

    var first = select.options[0];
    var frag = document.createDocumentFragment();

    var ph = document.createElement('option');
    ph.value = '';
    ph.textContent = (first && !first.value) ? first.text : 'Select one...';
    frag.appendChild(ph);

    values.forEach(function (v) {
      var o = document.createElement('option');
      o.value = v;
      o.textContent = v;
      frag.appendChild(o);
    });

    select.innerHTML = '';
    select.appendChild(frag);
    if (list.parentNode) list.parentNode.removeChild(list);
  }

  function init() { document.querySelectorAll('[cg-options-for]').forEach(build); }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  else init();
})();
</script>

(function () {

  document.addEventListener('input', function (e) {
    var input = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('[cg-data-element="country-search"]');

    modal.querySelectorAll('[cg-data-element="country-row"]').forEach(function (row) {

   platform name and description on the left, the price rows and the adopt button on the right.
